== Summary ==
AI-generated promotional art for the 2025 Beezer Bowl, showing porgs playing SWCCG at tournament tables under a "Star Wars Beezer Bowl 2025" title. A visible "ai" mark appears in the lower right corner.

* '''Event:''' 2025 Beezer Bowl (see [[2023 Beezer Bowl]])
* '''Supplied by:''' [[Bill Bisco]], 22 November 2026
* '''Source:''' [https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1184342427205648455/1393672276775538739 RetroClub Discord message], LargePorg (12 July 2025), posted with the 2025 Beezer Bowl stream announcement.
